review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its definitions against the concepts they might duplicate. The definitions are Joined, JoinedIn, pathSetoid, ZerothHomotopy (with mk, lift and rec), pathComponent, pathComponentIn, IsPathConnected, PathConnectedSpace, the pathComponentOne submonoid and subgroup, and the file's local instances. Each introduces path-specific notions. Joined is Nonempty (Path x y), and the file documents it as the relation behind pathSetoid and PathConnectedSpace. ZerothHomotopy.mk, lift and rec are thin named wrappers on Quotient and follow the same pattern as ConnectedComponents. They are tied to path components and carry the path-specific topology and instances. IsPathConnected and pathComponent are the path analogues of IsConnected and connectedComponent, and the file relates them by theorems such as pathComponent_subset_component. I found no independent, avoidable duplicate of an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept, so I abstain. I did not run exhaustive repository-wide greps for same-meaning declarations. That is the main residual uncertainty.
